# Everything But The House

> Everything But The House (EBTH) is a Blue Ash, Ohio online estate sale and consignment
> auction marketplace founded in 2008 by Jacquie Denny and Brian Graves. It runs curated,
> full-service online estate sales — cataloging, photography, appraisal, payment and
> shipping — for homeowners, estate managers, dealers and collectors, and sells the
> resulting antiques, fine art, jewelry, coins, watches, furniture and collectibles to
> buyers through timed online auctions where most lots open at one dollar.

**Generated by API Evangelist (https://apievangelist.com) on 2026-08-12.**
This file was NOT published by Everything But The House. `https://www.ebth.com/llms.txt`
returns HTTP 404. It is generated from the company's own public pages and from the probe
artifacts in this repository.

## API surface

Everything But The House publishes **no API**. There is no developer portal, no API
reference, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL SDL/JSON Schema, no SDK, no CLI, no webhook
catalog and no MCP server. Probed and confirmed on 2026-08-12:

- `https://www.ebth.com/developers` — 404
- `https://www.ebth.com/api` — 404
- `https://www.ebth.com/docs` — 404
- `https://www.ebth.com/openapi.json` — 404
- `https://www.ebth.com/swagger.json` — 404
- `https://www.ebth.com/api-docs` — 404
- `https://api.ebth.com/` and every spec path under it — 404 ("fault filter abort")
- `developer.ebth.com`, `developers.ebth.com`, `docs.ebth.com`, `mcp.ebth.com` — do not resolve in DNS
- `https://www.ebth.com/.well-known/agent-card.json` — 404
- `https://www.ebth.com/llms.txt` — 404

`https://www.ebth.com/graphql` exists (GET returns 422, the shape of a GraphQL endpoint
expecting a POST body), but it is an internal endpoint that powers the site's own
front end. `robots.txt` explicitly disallows `/graphql/`, so it was not introspected and
is not documented here. It is not a published product API.

The company's public GitHub organization, https://github.com/ebth, holds nine
repositories, all of them forks or small internal Ruby utilities (restforce, tax_cloud,
danger-rubocop, seed-fu, odbc_adapter, shortener, devise-async, usb-scale,
sfdc-apex-rollbar). None is an EBTH API client. The newest was last updated in 2021.

The iOS and Android apps (`com.ebth.ebth_webview`) are webview wrappers around ebth.com.

## Machine-readable surfaces that do exist

- [Status page JSON](https://status.ebth.com/api/status-page/public): Uptime Kuma public
  status-page document for `status.ebth.com`. Real JSON, HTTP 200.
- [Support community OIDC discovery](https://support.ebth.com/.well-known/openid-configuration):
  stock Salesforce Experience Cloud OpenID Connect discovery for the EBTH help-center
  community. Real JSON, HTTP 200. It authenticates help-center users; it is not a
  marketplace API and EBTH documents no client integration against it.
- [sitemap.xml](https://www.ebth.com/sitemap.xml): sitemap index over categories, pages,
  regions and item listings.

## Notes for agents

- `robots.txt` at https://www.ebth.com/robots.txt disallows `/cdn-cgi/`, `/admin/`,
  `/graphql/` and `/browse/` for all agents, and disallows the entire site for GPTBot,
  PetalBot, YandexBot, SemrushBot, SiteAuditBot and Mail.RU_Bot. Honor it.
- `status.ebth.com` answers HTTP 200 with an HTML SPA shell for every unmatched path.
  A 200 from that host is not evidence that a document exists.
- Domain security as probed 2026-08-12: TLS 1.3 on www.ebth.com, no HSTS, no DNSSEC,
  no CAA records, SPF present, DMARC present with `p=reject`.
- No security.txt, no vulnerability disclosure program and no trust center were found on
  any EBTH host.
